meta.name: mammoth_hunters_camp
meta.prompt: A Stone Age mammoth-hunters' camp at the foot of an ice sheet: huts of mammoth bone and hide, drying racks, a kill site on the tundra with the skeleton still in the snow.

programs.brief: A butchered mammoth skeleton half-buried in the snow at a tundra kill site: massive curved ivory tusks rearing up from red-dusted snow, huge arching ribcage, vertebrae, discarded flint scrapers, and trampled bloody snow.
A tall shamanic spirit post lashed together from mammoth tusks, skulls, and dried hide streamers, surrounded by a ring of mammoth vertebrae markers in the snow facing the ice sheet.
A crude A-frame rack lashed from mammoth ribs and spruce poles, hung with strips of dark drying meat and stretched scraped woolly mammoth pelts over a smoking hearth pit.
A piled cache of massive mammoth leg bones, jawbones, and tusks sorted for shelter framing and tool carving, dusted in drift snow.

tokens.terrain: open snowy tundra at the foot of a towering glacial ice sheet
tokens.icons: mammoth bone and hide shelters; timber drying racks for hides and meat; butchered mammoth skeleton half-buried in the snow at a nearby kill site; central fire hearths
tokens.infra: beaten snow paths between the shelters and the kill site
